selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the first thing asked from Allah in this passage?
questions.answer: To make us among the people of happiness, safety, the Qur’an, and belief.

questions.question: For whom are peace and blessings requested after that?
questions.answer: For Prophet Muhammad, and also for his family and companions.

questions.question: What holy book is mentioned in the prayer?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: How wide is the prayer for blessings on the Prophet described to be?
questions.answer: It is described as reaching the number of all the Qur’an’s letters in all its words.

questions.question: Whose recitation is included in that large number?
questions.answer: The recitation of every person who reads the Qur’an.

questions.question: From what time until what time does the passage include those recitations?
questions.answer: From the first revelation until the end of time.

questions.question: Besides us, which family members are especially included in the prayer for mercy?
questions.answer: Our parents.

questions.question: Which quality of Allah is especially called on when asking for mercy?
questions.answer: His unmatched mercy.

questions.question: What four blessings are asked for in the opening supplication?
questions.answer: Happiness, safety, the Qur’an, and belief.

questions.question: Which people connected to Prophet Muhammad are mentioned along with him?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: What picture is used to describe how Qur’an words are carried during recitation?
questions.answer: The movement of air is described like mirrors carrying those words.

questions.question: Who gives permission for that to happen, according to the prayer?
questions.answer: Allah, the Most Merciful.

questions.question: Which two groups of believers are mentioned clearly?
questions.answer: Believing men and believing women.

questions.question: What does the prayer teach about caring for others?
questions.answer: It teaches us to pray not only for ourselves, but also for our parents and all believers.

questions.question: What does the final line teach us to do after making du‘a?
questions.answer: To praise Allah.

questions.question: What does including all believing men and women show about Islam?
questions.answer: It teaches care for the whole believing community.

questions.question: In the first sentence, what kind of people are we asking Allah to let us be among?
questions.answer: People who have true success, protection, connection to the Qur’an, and faith.

questions.question: Which prophet is called “our Master” in the passage?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Is the prayer only for the Prophet himself, or for others with him too?
questions.answer: It is for him and also for his family and companions.

questions.question: What part of the Qur’an is counted in the prayer for blessings?
questions.answer: Its letters and words.

questions.question: What action causes those words to appear in the moving air, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The reading of the Qur’an by reciters.

questions.question: How long will people be included in this counting of recitation?
questions.answer: Until the end of time.

questions.question: Name three groups for whom mercy is requested.
questions.answer: Us, our parents, and all believing men and women.

questions.question: What name of Allah is used when asking for mercy at the end of the prayer?
questions.answer: The Most Merciful of the merciful.
